content:
American university George Mason in 2024 released paper titled Scalar Waves: A Globally Destabilizing Force. Paper argues that Russia and China have actively pursued scalar wave technology since the Cold War (citing Soviet "Tesla howitzers" at Saryshagan and recent Chinese advancements), while the U.S. abandoned it.
